phases.title: Authority and demand validation
phases.description: Confirm distinct company scope; validate three retailer pain scenarios using publicly available recalls and synthetic catalogs.
phases.exit_gate: Source/license review, no-cost prototype, documented customer assumptions, no customer outreach without authorization.

phases.title: Identity, source and safety foundation
phases.description: Company/project/Brain boundaries, official-source adapters, normalized recall schema, staleness/versioning, tenant isolation.
phases.exit_gate: Source fixtures, schema drift tests, explicit unknown; no sensitive data or outbound alerts.

phases.title: Catalog matching core
phases.description: SKU import, exact GTIN/model matching, lot/date predicates, confidence and explanation, manual review queue.
phases.exit_gate: Labeled evaluation set; high-consequence false negatives measured; ambiguous cases abstain.

phases.title: Evidence alerts and operations
phases.description: Source-linked alert workflow, correction/retraction tracking, audit exports, notifications with consent and dedupe.
phases.exit_gate: Safe dry-run, zero duplicate sends, notification approval tests and outage handling.

phases.title: First paid customer validation
phases.description: Customer authorization, trial-to-paid evidence, merchant workflow fit, retention and support cost measurement.
phases.exit_gate: Real customer opt-in and verified payment; no synthetic revenue.

phases.title: Coverage and vertical depth
phases.description: CPSC/FDA category packs, manufacturer notices, multilingual notices and multi-location rules.
phases.exit_gate: Per-source completeness and legal review, calibrated match performance.

phases.title: Integrations, API, OEM
phases.description: Catalog/ERP/PIM connectors, signed customer webhooks, reusable scopes, white label.
phases.exit_gate: Connector permissions, sandbox tests, backpressure and version contract.

phases.title: Scaling, recovery, improvement
phases.description: Multi-customer operating evidence, data lifecycle, drift monitoring, horizontal capacity and approved future innovation.
phases.exit_gate: SLO and restoration drills; cost proposal only; no automatic paid scale.

phases.title: Carrier/market feasibility
phases.description: Choose carrier and service under known free/licensed access; document guarantee policies and actual account eligibility.
phases.exit_gate: No code relies on unverified API/refund eligibility; synthetic examples only.

phases.title: Shipment/event state foundation
phases.description: First-class project/Brain; shipping entity and event journal; idempotent tracking adapter; authorization boundaries.
phases.exit_gate: Out-of-order/replayed tracking tests and no credential exposure.

phases.title: Exception classification
phases.description: Service-specific exception logic, delivery clocks, advisory versions, evidence and uncertainty.
phases.exit_gate: False-positive case evaluation and time-zone/holiday tests.

phases.title: Eligibility/claim preparation
phases.description: Current carrier policy citations, deadline system, evidence packet and separate claim approval gate.
phases.exit_gate: No automatic filing or financial action; policy change rejects stale rules.

phases.title: Actual-credit reconciliation
phases.description: Claim receipt tracking, credits verified against statements, distinct customer refunds, accurate reporting.
phases.exit_gate: Zero synthetic revenue, zero duplicate claim IDs and equal-credit reconciliation.

phases.title: First merchant validation
phases.description: Authorized merchant trial with shipment volume, exception burden, policy eligibility and service value evidence.
phases.exit_gate: Actual operator feedback and first real paid evidence before scaling.

phases.title: Carrier and platform expansion
phases.description: More account-scoped carrier adapters, ecommerce and 3PL connectors, support desk integration.
phases.exit_gate: Each carrier has separate legality, credentials, replay/coverage and financial gates.

phases.title: Optimization and scale
phases.description: Versioned event analytics, policy drift, enterprise dashboards, recovery/migration, low-cost capacity design.
phases.exit_gate: Measured unit economics; capacity cost proposals only, never auto-spend.

phases.title: Evidence, product and demo
phases.description: Verify current KDP/EPUB requirements and author scope; generate sample public-domain book and sample QA report.
phases.exit_gate: Real source formats verified, customer ownership rules and free tools licensed.

phases.title: Secure intake and semantic engine
phases.description: Client isolation, source scanning, structure tree, metadata, style presets, versioning and author approval.
phases.exit_gate: Source diff preserves 100% original text except approved changes.

phases.title: EPUB workflow
phases.description: EPUB3 generation, navigation, accessibility, image/footnote validation and device proof set.
phases.exit_gate: EPUBCheck passing and independent visual QA.

phases.title: Print production workflow
phases.description: Trim/bleed/gutter, typography, paperback/hardcover interior PDF, image/font QC, mechanical cover check.
phases.exit_gate: Current KDP rules, no trim/bleed violations and manual proof pass.

phases.title: Customer production workflow
phases.description: Quote/scope, revision approvals, secure delivery, source rebuild receipts and support.
phases.exit_gate: One complete mock customer order, secure file separation and no auto-publishing.

phases.title: First authorized paid customers
phases.description: Validate quality, price, turnaround, rework/refund policy and customer satisfaction.
phases.exit_gate: Actual payment and final deliverables; no fabricated sales.

phases.title: Expanded genre and channel profiles
phases.description: Workbooks, cookbooks, poetry, picture books, large-print, additional retailers with official specs.
phases.exit_gate: Each profile independently accepted with realistic specimen tests.

phases.title: Automation and scale
phases.description: Background job queue, genre QA/evals, author portal, series templates, no-cost capacity/recovery.
phases.exit_gate: Demand/cost/quality evidence; owner approves any paid scaling separately.

phases.title: Demand and scope
phases.description: Validate contractor niches, client willingness to pay, separate from RevoCapture and existing #029.
phases.exit_gate: Clear owner-approved product boundaries and owned demo data.

phases.title: Template/data/privacy foundation
phases.description: One static trade template, intake schema, approved content/image rights, per-client site isolation.
phases.exit_gate: Zero unintended use of garage company assets or data; access and mobile QA.

phases.title: Contact and booking request workflow
phases.description: Functional form, secure receiver, request status, calendar read integration optional, anti-spam.
phases.exit_gate: End-to-end synthetic lead delivered to correct owner; never fake confirmed appointment.

phases.title: Multi-device and public readiness QA
phases.description: Accessibility, performance, HTTPS, responsive screenshots, SEO markup, content truth, backup.
phases.exit_gate: Automated + human functional/visual checklist passes.

phases.title: First customer service delivery
phases.description: Client quote/approval, template customization, deploy under authorized account, handoff source and docs.
phases.exit_gate: Real client signoff, no unauthorized domain purchase or spend.

phases.title: Maintenance and analytics
phases.description: Broken forms/links monitors, approved updates, consented analytics, routine incident recovery.
phases.exit_gate: Verified maintenance run with owner notification on failure.

phases.title: Cross-vertical and optional integrations
phases.description: Expand to 5+ trades, multi-location, CRM/read-only booking, RevoCapture opt-in.
phases.exit_gate: No scope/credential leakage and reuse tests for each trade pack.

phases.title: Agency/operator scale
phases.description: Independent customer build jobs, bounded concurrent builds, release governance, customer offboarding.
phases.exit_gate: Measured quality/support effort and free-tier capacity; owner-only spending decisions.

phases.title: Scope/rights/hardware feasibility
phases.description: Company isolation, owned demo footage, legal processing consent; inspect laptop CPU/RAM/disk and no-cost tools.
phases.exit_gate: One full sample can be processed locally without server or spend.

phases.title: Local media ingestion and transcription
phases.description: FFprobe/FFmpeg, checksum vault, offline ASR and transcript/timecode trace.
phases.exit_gate: Hardware benchmark, corrupt/multiple format tests, no file leakage.

phases.title: Highlight and editorial selection
phases.description: Topic/speaker segmentation, hook/context scoring, reviewable candidate clips, no misleading splice.
phases.exit_gate: Human-labeled clip rubric and high-confidence abstain cases.

phases.title: Video/caption render and QA
phases.description: Aspect ratio reframing, captions/audio, platform profiles, encoder/retry, automated visual/audio QC.
phases.exit_gate: SRT accuracy, caption legibility, A/V sync, no clipping/black frames.

phases.title: Client delivery and service operation
phases.description: Package design, review/revisions, private delivery, consent/rights receipts, customer support.
phases.exit_gate: One synthetic client order end-to-end and clean offboarding.

phases.title: First authorized paid customers
phases.description: Validate repeat demand and real deliverable quality on existing laptop within capacity.
phases.exit_gate: Verified payments, customer approval and no manual workload overclaim.

phases.title: Local automation and vertical templates
phases.description: Queue/recovery/scheduled tasks, client style kits, podcast/webinar/education/commerce variants.
phases.exit_gate: Continuous regression with no performance/quality regression or paid features.

phases.title: Optional approved infrastructure scale
phases.description: Serverless/cloud/hardware alternatives evaluated only after real demand; optional client portal and capacity.
phases.exit_gate: Cost/quality proposal to owner; no purchase, deployment or paid action automatically.
